paper.note: Sleeved and played. Checked in from the pilot's paper list 2026-09-07; drift is computed against this from here.

v1.0.0.note: The paper list, checked in 2026-09-07 from the pilot's own sleeved deck. Replaces the placeholder that pointed at V5: the fifteen-card difference is the Aetherflux Reservoir kill coming out and a counters-and-X-spell-tokens package going in.

v1.0.1.note: The basics rebalanced, -5 Island +5 Plains. Deterministic: the optimum of the Island/Plains sweep on the worst colour. White on-curve 0.446 -> 0.610; commander cast by t6 80% -> 88%. No card bought, none cut.

v1.1.0.note: Guardian of Faith, Karametra's Blessing, Lightning Greaves and Leyline of Anticipation in; the three hand-size punishers and Tireless Tribe out. MINOR, not patch: the deck can do something it could not before — keep its commander alive against a 45% removal rate, and act at instant speed without him. Accepted on the decomposition of 119 measured departures rather than on a Forge A/B, which at 100 games per arm could not have resolved anything under +0.19.

v1.2.0.note: The skies package: Angelic Wall, Kefnet the Mindful, Drift of Phantasms and Ghostly Prison in; Wall of Glare, Darien, United Front and The Ozolith out. MINOR: the deck can block a flier and tax an attacker, neither of which it could do before, against a measured 39-of-53 elimination rate from a deck whose every threat flies.

v1.2.1.note: Archangel of Tithes in for White Sun's Zenith. Pip-neutral at three white either way; it deepens the flier-and-taxer axis v1.2.0 opened rather than adding a new one, which is why it is a patch and not a minor — the scheme's 'patch = mana only' does not quite cover a card swap, and this is the nearest honest reading.
